fine_lines.title: -est vs most
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصفات القصيرة (مقطع واحد، أو مقطعان تنتهي بـ y) تأخذ the + est: nicest, silliest, luckiest. الصفات الطويلة (مقطعان أو أكثر) تأخذ the most: the most serious, the most famous.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Short adjectives (one syllable, or two syllables ending in -y) take the + -est: nicest, silliest, luckiest. Longer adjectives take the most: the most serious, the most famous.

examples.sentence: Marsha is the nicest person I know.
They are the friendliest people in the city.
It is one of the most famous restaurants.

fine_lines.title: good / better / best
fine_lines.explanation_ar: good صفة شاذة: المقارنة better والتفضيل the best. لا نقول goodest أو most good.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Good" is irregular: good → better → the best. Never say "goodest".

grammar.title: Superlative adjectives with -est
grammar.explanation_ar: صيغة التفضيل تقارن شيئاً بكل أفراد مجموعته: the + صفة + est. القواعد: nice → the nicest (نضيف st فقط). messy, silly, friendly, lucky → نحذف y ونضيف iest: the messiest, the silliest, the friendliest, the luckiest. big → the biggest (نضاعف الحرف).
grammar.explanation_en: A superlative compares one thing with all the others in a group: the + adjective + -est. nice → the nicest (add -st). messy, silly, friendly, lucky → change y to i + est: the messiest, the silliest, the friendliest, the luckiest. big → the biggest (double the letter).
examples: Marsha is the nicest person I know.
I'm the messiest cook she knows.
They are the friendliest people I know.
I am the luckiest woman in Washington, D.C.

grammar.title: Superlatives with the most
grammar.explanation_ar: الصفات الطويلة (ذات المقطعين أو أكثر ولا تنتهي بـ y) تأخذ the most + الصفة: the most serious, the most famous, the most interesting.
grammar.explanation_en: Long adjectives (two or more syllables, not ending in -y) use the most + adjective: the most serious, the most famous, the most interesting.
examples: You are the most famous turkey farmer I know!
one of D.C.'s most famous restaurants

grammar.title: Irregular superlative: the best / Of all the... / one of the...
grammar.explanation_ar: good → the best (شاذة). نستخدم بعد التفضيل: of all the people I know، in the city، I know. ومع one of the نستخدم الاسم بالجمع: one of the most famous restaurants.
grammar.explanation_en: good → the best (irregular). After a superlative we often say: of all the people I know, in the city, I know. With "one of the" use a plural noun: one of the most famous restaurants.
examples: That is the best job for you!
Of all the people I know, Pete is the silliest.
